requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个节能照明系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、人体接近检测 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、PWM LED D9 和按钮 D2。只有当环境较暗且检测到有人接近时才自动点亮 LED；按钮用于强制常亮模式与自动模式切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_4 rising edge (press) while io_0=10.0, io_2=false
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_5=true and io_3=255.0 after the button press step (manual forced-on).

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个节能照明系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、人体接近检测 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、PWM LED D9 和按钮 D2。只有当环境较暗且检测到有人接近时才自动点亮 LED；按钮用于强制常亮模式与自动模式切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Second button press (another rising edge on io_4) while io_0=10.0, io_2=false
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_5=false and io_3=0.0 after the second press step (returned to auto; no approach validity so LED off).

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个节能照明系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、人体接近检测 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、PWM LED D9 和按钮 D2。只有当环境较暗且检测到有人接近时才自动点亮 LED；按钮用于强制常亮模式与自动模式切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: No button press; set io_0=10.0, io_2=true
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_5=true and io_3=255.0 (auto-on when approach valid; brightness condition satisfied by io_0>0).

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个节能照明系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、人体接近检测 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、PWM LED D9 和按钮 D2。只有当环境较暗且检测到有人接近时才自动点亮 LED；按钮用于强制常亮模式与自动模式切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: No button press; set io_0=0.0, io_2=true
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_5=false and io_3=0.0 (auto remains off when environment-brightness gate fails: io_0>0 not satisfied).
